faq.question: What should I check before signing a commercial lease?
faq.summary: Verify 6 critical points: exact written termination notice (60-90 days), clear maintenance separation (structural vs operational), renewal rent increase cap (8-10%), security deposit refund terms, municipal commercial zoning, and Section 155 tax withholding allocation.
faq.legal_basis: Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009 / Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance / Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 155)

faq.question: Can I terminate this contract early, and what notice is required?
faq.summary: Early termination depends on your contract clause. Avoid 'reasonable notice' and specify exact days. For breach of contract, a 14-30 day formal Notice to Cure is legally required before termination.

faq.question: Who is responsible for taxes or withholding on this payment?
faq.summary: Every business is responsible for its own income tax. However, corporate payers are legally mandated by FBR to withhold tax at source (e.g. 8-11% on services, scaled rates on rent). Contracts should state whether amounts are inclusive or exclusive of taxes.
faq.legal_basis: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Sections 152, 153, 155) & Provincial Sales Tax on Services Acts

faq.question: What records should my business maintain for tax purposes?
faq.summary: Under Section 174, maintain serially numbered sales invoices, vendor receipts, utility bills, business bank account statements, and salary payment CPRs for a minimum of 6 years.
faq.legal_basis: Income Tax Ordinance 2001, Section 174 & Income Tax Rules 2002 (Rule 29)

faq.question: What registrations or compliance steps apply to my business?
faq.summary: A 4-tier structure: (1) FBR Iris NTN, (2) Entity registration (SECP or Registrar of Firms), (3) Provincial Sales Tax on Services (PRA/SRB), and (4) Sectoral licensing (PSEB for IT exporters to claim 0.25% tax rate).
faq.legal_basis: FBR Iris Guidelines / SECP Companies Act 2017 / PSEB Policy Guidelines
